name: daintree.beads
description: First-party Beads issues provider — pick beads from a bd serve server for worktrees, on bead/<id> branches, while your code forge keeps pull requests and CI.
tagline: Beads issues for your worktrees, alongside your code forge

settings.label: Beads server URL
settings.description: The address of the bd serve this project's beads come from. Leave it empty to use the one bd connect recorded in the project's .beads/http_target.json.

credentialFields.label: Server token
credentialFields.helpText: The bearer token from the file bd serve was started with (--auth-token-file). A server started without one needs none.
